title: Elixir of Human Versatility
summary: Gain proficiency in all skills until Long Rest.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Consume one bottle. Gain proficiency in all skills until Long Rest.
fields.Acquisition: Trade human blood to Araj Oblodra in Moonrise Towers or the Lower City.
fields.Stacking: Araj’s elixirs stack with ordinary elixirs and other Araj elixirs.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
